weather.state: Clear around 17C near the match window; dry evening signal with no demonstrated directional team edge.

evidence_findings.observation: Official NRL late mail states no further Sharks changes at the 90-minute update. Hohepa Puru remains out and Niwhai Puru remains in the interchange utility role; Braydon Trindall remains cleared to return.
Cowboys game-day switch: John Bateman starts in the second row and Jeremiah Nanai moves to the bench. Griffin Neame, Zac Laybutt and Reuben Cotter remain available.
Sportsbet remains Sharks $1.47 / Cowboys $2.67. No verified cause is assigned to prior movement toward North Queensland.

player_effects: Sharks core spine remains intact; Trindall return uncertainty is retained without medical inference.
Cowboys move Bateman into the starting edge and Nanai to interchange; treated as a role/rotation change, not a directional medical inference.
player_statistical_trend_effects: Persistent player dossiers remain active. No new verified per-round publication at this checkpoint supports a new causal trend claim.

team_macro_effects.Sharks: No material new continuity gain; recent-form weakness and neutral venue remain active counterweights.
team_macro_effects.Cowboys: Verified returns remain intact; Bateman/Nanai role switch slightly changes edge rotation but does not independently justify a team switch.

matchup_effects: Cowboys Round 8 win and Sharks 14-of-last-17 historical record are retained as observed history only.
evidence_family_independence: Market, season differential, recent scoring, official availability, matchup history, weather and player dossiers are not counted as independent duplicates.
adversarial_counter_case: North Queensland retain the verified return group, prior Round 8 success, Cronulla's weak recent results and a market that has previously moved toward the Cowboys. The Bateman/Nanai switch preserves rather than removes the counter-case.
falsification: Reduce or switch from Sharks if the ten-minutes-before-kickoff lists materially weaken Cronulla spine/middle continuity, materially strengthen North Queensland continuity, or a fresh independent football mechanism supports a further Cowboys move.
mayhem_inference: The new role switch does not overcome the structural and market-aligned Sharks baseline. No pseudo-precise uplift is added.
